scenarios.name: stalled_consumer_overflow
scenarios.fault_injected: Client ceases reading while publisher ingests 50 rapid events
scenarios.expected_behavior: Client queue capped at maxsize=10; 40 events dropped; counter incremented; zero publisher blocking
scenarios.observed_behavior: Queue depth held at 10; dropped=40; producer latency unaffected

scenarios.name: noisy_neighbor_auto_eviction
scenarios.fault_injected: Client drops exceed eviction threshold (10 drops)
scenarios.expected_behavior: Client automatically severed and de-registered; total_evictions incremented
scenarios.observed_behavior: Client deleted from active sessions; total_evictions=1; memory reclaimed

scenarios.name: stale_leader_fencing
scenarios.fault_injected: Old primary attempts write with Epoch 1 after failover advanced epoch to 2
scenarios.expected_behavior: Immediate FencingTokenError raised; zero bytes written to WAL; stale_writes_rejected incremented
scenarios.observed_behavior: FencingTokenError raised in 1.4 us; stale_writes_rejected=1; WAL untouched

scenarios.name: network_partition_quorum_loss
scenarios.fault_injected: Node partitioned from 2 of 3 cluster peers (majority unreachable)
scenarios.expected_behavior: QuorumLossError raised; leadership acquisition and lease renewal blocked

scenarios.name: lease_expiration_write_rejection
scenarios.fault_injected: Leader attempts write after lease duration expires without renewal
scenarios.expected_behavior: FencingTokenError raised; write rejected prior to persistence
scenarios.observed_behavior: Write rejected with Epoch lease expired error

scenarios.name: incoming_buffer_saturation
scenarios.fault_injected: 250 events published into paused dispatcher with capacity=100
scenarios.expected_behavior: Incoming queue capped at 100; oldest 150 events shed; total_dropped incremented
scenarios.observed_behavior: Queue depth=100; total_dropped=150; bounded heap preserved
